notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.2.5 bundles Browser CRM V2.0 with integrated Twilio browser calling. Any lead with a phone number can be called from anywhere in the CRM, including Want to Contact and outside the Call Queue. V2 adds Dialling/Ringing/Connected states, headset audio through Twilio Voice JS SDK 2.18.5, mute, hang up, DTMF keypad, call timer and existing CRM outcome/follow-up logging. Twilio credentials are configured inside Browser CRM Settings and stored with Windows OS-backed encryption; the browser only receives short-lived access tokens. FirstSeen can test an existing TwiML App and create/update its Voice URL after a TwiML Bin is created.
